input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including user. The platform provides capabilities for extend property sources environment post processor, user mx bean, calculating. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a Admin, I want to interact with hello world functionality, so that I can accomplish my hello world-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to use extend property sources environment post processor capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use calculating capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
